working_on.feature: Infinite Loop Timeout Setting (0 = No Limit)
working_on.task: Converted default timeoutPerLoopMinutes from 15 to 0 (infinite timeout), disabled timer watchdog when timeout <= 0, verified test suite passes, and packaged VSIX 1.6.1.
working_on.notes: Setting autoplan.timeoutPerLoopMinutes to 0 disables the setTimeout loop timer entirely, allowing phases to wait indefinitely until keyword completion or manual user abortion.

recent_changes.description: Updated timeoutPerLoopMinutes default to 0 (infinite), updated schema, config, transcript watcher, and packaged VSIX.

decisions_made: Follow standard VS Code extension convention: 0 represents infinite / no timeout limit.
When timeoutPerLoopMinutes <= 0, TranscriptWatcher does not instantiate activeTimer setTimeout.
When timeoutPerLoopMinutes <= 0, Orchestrator watchdogThreshold is 0 to avoid false stall alerts.
